He said: When the discourse on reliance on God (exalted be He) has come before us, I saw fit to follow that with the explication of the aspects of the purification of the works of obedience for God alone, on account of what is in this of the clarifying of inner beings and the cleansing of hearts from the admixture that corrupts them, and of the safeguarding from the kinds of self-adornment leading to ostentation, to affectation, and to the flattering of created beings — as Elihu said: "Let me, I pray, lift the face of no man, and let me not give honor to the human being; for I do not know how to give honor — in a little while my Maker would take me away" (Job 32:21–22).
